en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a formal outdoor gathering in a tree‑lined public garden. Numerous men in military and naval uniforms and a few women in white dresses are seated or standing in rows, as if for an official group portrait. Flags hang among the trees. At the top a date is handwritten, and across the bottom there is a long handwritten message in Greek. Printed French text near the bottom left identifies the place, and a modern Greek website watermark appears on the right.
